directors had
verified by June
slides.subtitle: Companies House ID checks for existing directors and PSCs close in mid-November. Here is the six-step list we would work through this week.

slides.label: List everyone who has to verify
slides.detail: Every director, LLP member and PSC (a person with significant control) needs to verify. That includes you if you are the only director, and any shareholder who controls the company.
slides.start: Write down every director and PSC on your company, starting with yourself.

slides.label: Verify online, free, in minutes
slides.detail: The quickest route is GOV.UK One Login with a passport or other photo ID. It is free and usually takes about fifteen minutes. A Post Office or an authorised agent can do it instead.
slides.start: Search for 'verifying your identity for Companies House' and check the address ends gov.uk.

slides.label: Save your personal code
slides.detail: Once verified you get an 11 character personal code. Companies House needs it linked to you, and it is what goes into your filings. Lose it and you are chasing support during the busiest week.
slides.start: Sign in to Companies House, open Manage account, and save the code in your password manager.

slides.label: Check your next confirmation statement
slides.detail: A confirmation statement cannot be filed unless every director has verified. For many companies that date falls before the November deadline, so one unverified director can stall your filing early.
slides.start: Find your next confirmation statement date and chase any director who has not verified.

slides.label: Distrust any email about it
slides.detail: Companies House has warned that scammers are copying this rollout with fake emails and links. Genuine verification starts on gov.uk, never from a message telling you to act now.
slides.start: Tell your team: nobody clicks an ID verification link from an email. Type the address in.

slides.label: Do it now, not in the last week
slides.detail: At June's end only 55% of directors and 42% of PSCs had verified. Millions of people are queuing for the same deadline. Acting as an unverified director is an offence, so a late job is a risky one.
slides.start: Block fifteen minutes in your diary this week and verify before you do anything else.

title: Verify this week.
Not the last week.
slides.body: This is the checklist we would hand a client who asked what to do before the Companies House deadline. Check your own due date on the register.
slides.cta: Does every director and PSC at your company have their personal code yet?
